title: Recruitment screening
bodyMd:
Every application receives the same screening rubric. A pass means eligibility for interview, not a job offer.

| Category | Applications | Screening passes |
|---|---:|---:|
| Technical | 100 | 40 |
| Commercial | 150 | 90 |
| Support | 250 | 125 |
